% A CMYK raster tagged with the same CMYK profile the output intent carries. PDF/X-4 forbids it (ISO 15930-7, 6.4.3.3):
% colour already prepared for the printing condition belongs in DeviceCMYK.
\documentclass{article}
\input{pdfraw}
\pagestyle{empty}
\PdfProfile{cmyk}{cmyk.icc}{4}
\PdfImage{/Im1}{2}{2}{8}{\PdfICC{cmyk}}{ff000000 00ff0000 0000ff00 000000ff}
\PdfIntent{cmyk}{Sample CMYK}
\begin{document}
\PdfDraw{q 140 0 0 140 100 500 cm /Im1 Do Q}
\end{document}
